The `upstreamValidatorsPass` check is vulnerable to silent passes if any expected validator is completely missing from the `validators` object. Because it only checks `Object.values(validators)`, any omitted keys will not be checked, and the validator will pass. To prevent this, explicitly verify that all expected validator keys are present and have the status `'pass'`, and ensure the check fails closed gracefully if `validators` is null or malformed.

```javascript
  const expectedValidators = [
    'amendment_boundary_validator',
    'payload_schema_validator',
    'question_source_inventory_validator',

    'frontend_fixture_validator',
    'rehearsal_validator',
    'frontend_handoff_validator',
    'prior_review_closeout_validator'
  ];
  const upstreamValidatorsPass = !!validators && typeof validators === 'object' && expectedValidators.every((key) => validators[key] === 'pass');
```

+  const fixtureCoverageValid = [
+    'pre_attempt_blocked',
+    'submitted_answer_reveal_allowed',
+    'student_confirmed_attempt_reveal_allowed',
+    'teacher_admin_preview_student_rejected',
+    'page_reveal_neighbor_warning',
+    'document_only_default_unavailable',
+    'self_assessment_submitted',
+    'copilot_explain_deferred_future_authorization',

+    no_accepted_crop_without_visual_qa_check:

+    frontend_no_preload_check:

+        inputs.frontendHandoff?.no_preload_static_asset_policy?.do_not_preload_ms_source_assets_before_reveal_eligibility === true
+        ? 'pass'

+        : 'visual_qa_required_for_promoted_screenshots',

+
+function futureAuthorizationGates() {
+  return REQUIRED_FUTURE_GATES.map(([gateId, description]) => ({
+    gate_id: gateId,
+    status: 'future_authorization_required',
+    completed_by_issue_1465: false,
+    description,
+  }));
+}
+
+function makeCheck(id, passed, summary, observed = {}) {
+  return { id, status: passed ? 'pass' : 'fail', summary, observed };
+}
+
+function inventoryComplete(inventory) {
+  return Object.values(isRecord(inventory) ? inventory : {}).every((entry) => (
+    arrayFrom(entry?.paths).length > 0 &&
+      arrayFrom(entry.paths).every((item) => item?.exists === true && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(String(item.sha256)))
+  ));
+}
+
+function liveIssueChainClosedAndMerged(issues) {
+  return arrayFrom(issues).filter((issue) => issue.issue >= 1453 && issue.issue <= 1464)
+    .every((issue) => issue.state === 'CLOSED' && issue.pr_state === 'MERGED');
+}
body: Fixed. `liveIssueChainClosedAndMerged` now requires every dependency issue #1453-#1464 to be present and CLOSED/MERGED, and the regression test omits #1464 to prove it fails closed.

+  const validators = isRecord(c.upstream_validator_statuses) ? c.upstream_validator_statuses : {};

+  if (c.live_issue_pr_map?.issues !== undefined && !Array.isArray(c.live_issue_pr_map.issues)) {

+  }
+  if (c.future_authorization_gates !== undefined && !Array.isArray(c.future_authorization_gates)) {
+    errors.push('future_authorization_gates_not_an_array');
+  }
+  for (const diagnostic of arrayFrom(c.input_diagnostics)) {
+    if (diagnostic?.code) errors.push(`${diagnostic.code}:${diagnostic.role ?? 'unknown_input'}`);
+  }
+
+  if (counts.ms_reveal_payload_row_count !== EXPECTED_ROW_COUNT) {
+    errors.push('ms_reveal_payload_row_count_not_3530');
+  }
+  if (counts.missing_payload_row_count !== 0) {
+    errors.push('missing_payload_row_count_not_zero');
+  }
+  addZeroCountErrors(counts, errors);
+  addSideEffectErrors(sideEffects, errors);
+  addFutureGateErrors(gates, errors);
+
+  const upstreamValidatorsPass =
+    Object.keys(validators).length > 0 && Object.values(validators).every((status) => status === 'pass');

+        counts.visual_qa_fail_count === 0 &&
+        counts.visual_qa_blocked_count === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    no_student_display_candidate_without_visual_qa_check:
+      counts.student_display_candidate_without_visual_qa_count === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    no_accepted_crop_without_visual_qa_check:
+      counts.accepted_crop_without_visual_qa_count === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    frontend_no_preload_check:
+      counts.frontend_preload_exposure_count === 0 &&
+        inputs.frontendHandoff?.no_preload_static_asset_policy?.do_not_preload_ms_source_assets_before_reveal_eligibility === true
+        ? 'pass'
+        : 'fail',
+    side_effect_receipt_all_zero:
+      SIDE_EFFECT_ZERO_FIELDS.every((field) => numberFrom(sideEffects[field]) === 0) &&
+        sideEffects.remote_disposable_supabase_write_authorized === false &&
+        sideEffects.remote_disposable_supabase_write_requires_future_authorization === true ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    upstream_validators_pass: validatorsPass ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    row_contract_coverage_check:
+      counts.ms_reveal_payload_row_count === EXPECTED_ROW_COUNT &&
+        counts.missing_payload_row_count === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    asset_delivery_record_count: assetRecords.length,
+    codex_worker_visual_qa_posture:
+      numberFrom(receiptSummary.generated_screenshot_count) === 0
+        ? 'no_generated_screenshots_promoted_beyond_candidate_internal'
+        : 'visual_qa_required_for_promoted_screenshots',
+  };
+}
+
+function futureAuthorizationGates() {
+  return REQUIRED_FUTURE_GATES.map(([gateId, description]) => ({
+    gate_id: gateId,
+    status: 'future_authorization_required',
+    completed_by_issue_1465: false,
+    description,
+  }));
+}
+
+function makeCheck(id, passed, summary, observed = {}) {
+  return { id, status: passed ? 'pass' : 'fail', summary, observed };
+}
+
+function inventoryComplete(inventory) {
+  return Object.values(isRecord(inventory) ? inventory : {}).every((entry) => (
+    arrayFrom(entry?.paths).length > 0 &&
+      arrayFrom(entry.paths).every((item) => item?.exists === true && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(String(item.sha256)))
+  ));
+}
body: Fixed. `inventoryComplete` now validates the full expected inventory-key set instead of iterating only over present keys, and the regression test deletes `reveal_payload_schema` to prove it fails closed.
